faqs.question: Do you write in Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes — native bilingual captions and copy, written naturally for each language rather than translated word-for-word.

faqs.question: Will it match our brand voice?
faqs.answer: Yes — we define your voice up front so every caption sounds consistently like you.

faqs.question: Do you deliver in Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes — bilingual Arabic + English with full RTL support, so both audiences get a first-class experience.

faqs.question: Do we own the result?
faqs.answer: Completely. You keep the accounts, data, and configurations. There is no lock-in to CloudTopia.
